title: Noah's Ark Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Noah’s Ark Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Noah's Ark Bible crossword: the flood, the dove, and the ark of Genesis 6–9 in a 15×15 grid of KJV-rooted clues. Free daily puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Forty days of rain, an ark of gopher wood, and a dove carrying an olive leaf — the flood story is one of the most vivid in all of Scripture, and it makes a wonderful crossword. In Noah and the Flood, every clue comes straight from Genesis 6–9: the animals gathered two by two, the single door in the ark's side, the waters that covered the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

It's one of the hand-crafted puzzles in Bible Crossword Challenge, and if you're short on time, the archive also holds a quick 7×7 mini on the same story. Finish the grid and it closes the way every puzzle does — on the verse behind the theme.

clues.text: Bird sent out that returned with an olive leaf
The great waters that covered the earth
Gopher material from which the ark was made
The single opening in the side of the ark

verseText: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark.
